judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message and type names entirely (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage` instead of `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`). It completely omitted the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history` flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, instead returning an empty list when `listFor` is missing—which the issue explicitly forbade. Furthermore, its `limit` validation accepts `0` and values over `200`, directly violating the acceptance criteria requiring `limit` to be an integer from 1 to 200. It also left an artifact file `.lore/dod.md` in the repository and missed updating `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`.
